service.description: The registration events of the caller's organizations (an organization's, or a campaign's when marketingCampaignId names one of them, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), by text (name or place), the first occurrence's date range and the offers' state (ErpDraft, ErpPublished or none), soonest first, a page at a time: each with its organization, when in its zone, where, campaigns, offers, the confirmed, held and waitlisted places against the seats, and its state. Any Marketing reader (PERMISSION_DENIED for a caller who reads nothing of Marketing); canCreate for an events manager.

One registration event for RegistrationSetup and its tabs: the event (when, where, online or not, repeating, campaigns, places against seats), each offer with its window, seats and places taken, hold, waitlist, terms, site, store, ticket types (each priced by its source, never an amount of its own), questions, notices, readiness checks and public address once published, the occurrences still to come with no offer, and what the caller may do (canManage: MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE; canEditEvent: the calendar's own rule). Any Marketing reader of the event's organization; another organization's event is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

Offers registration for a calendar event (a WetEvent) by an internal organization of the caller's scope, once: an events manager (MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE) who may edit the event (its organizer or an editor of its calendar, EVENT_EDIT_REQUIRED otherwise); the same organization again changes nothing, another is ORGANIZATION_FIXED. With marketingCampaignId, the event's link to an open campaign of that organization (CampaignAssociation CakEvent, made once) through mantle.marketing.CampaignServices.store#CampaignAssociation, a change of the campaign: the caller also holds MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT (CAMPAIGN_EDIT_REQUIRED otherwise). Called after mantle.work.EventServices.create#Event by NewEvent.

A registration offer for one occurrence of a registration event (new: workEffortId and, for a series, occurrenceStart, the start its rule gives the occurrence; OCCURRENCE_REQUIRED, OCCURRENCE_UNAVAILABLE, OCCURRENCE_PAST, OFFER_EXISTS) or a change of one at the revision read (registrationPolicyId, expectedRevision): its public title and description, the zone its times are shown in, the site (an enabled Marketing mount of the organization), an optional store of the organization (a store order; storeless by default), the window (WINDOW_INVALID), the seats (never fewer than the places held or confirmed now: CAPACITY_BELOW_TAKEN), the hold in minutes, the waitlist, the terms and cancellation terms (a change after publication raises termsRevision) and the notices' sending profile. A closed offer is not changed (POLICY_CLOSED). MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

A ticket type of an offer (new: registrationPolicyId) or a change at the revision read (ticketTypeId, expectedRevision), or its end (action end): its name, price source (EtpFree, or EtpProduct with a ticket product the organization sells, not kept in inventory, linked to the event by WorkEffortProduct; no amount is kept), its places within the offer's seats (never fewer than its places held or confirmed: CAPACITY_BELOW_TAKEN), its sales dates and the places one order may take (1 to 50). A ticket type with places taken keeps its product. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

An offer's registration questions at its revision read: a published registration form (purpose DbfpRegistration) of the organization (FORM_INVALID, FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED), kept as the offer's publication of purpose registration (Commons' FormPublication: anonymous, on the offer's site, open while the offer is; a new form closes the earlier one, an empty formId ends them), whom they are for (ErqAttendee, ErqBuyer) and the consent text a registrant accepts with them (a change after publication raises termsRevision). MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

A notice of an offer (new: registrationPolicyId) or a change at the revision read (scheduleId, expectedRevision), or its end (action end): its trigger (confirmed, before the start, after the end, changed, cancelled) and offset in minutes, an email template of the organization in use, whom it goes to and its kind (transactional under the registration's authority, or promotional, which needs the recipient's promotional consent; a promotional template is never a transactional notice). Sent by P17's job, once per registration, through the delivery ledger. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

Publishes a draft offer at its revision read when it is ready (NOT_READY naming each missing check): an occurrence still to come of an event not cancelled, seats, a ticket type, each paid ticket priced in the organization's currency, a window that closes after it opens and by the occurrence's end, a published site whose Marketing mount serves the organization, a ready transactional sending profile for the notices, a payment gateway of the organization (or of the offer's store) when a ticket has a price, and the questions' form published when it has questions. Its question publication opens with it. Answers the PASS Event page's address. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

Closes an offer at its revision read (with a reason): its page is no longer available and its question publication closes; the places taken stay. Once only. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

An online event's call (design §9 EventDetail "Add video call", L7): a call link of the framework (lobby, video, lasting past its offers' last occurrence) as the event's join address (WorkEffort.infoUrl), once (CALL_EXISTS). An events manager of the event's organization who may edit the event. Registrants receive the link with their confirmation (P17); the public page says the event is online and never shows it.

The registrations of an offer, an event's offers or every offer of the caller's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for another organization's), by state, ticket type and a name, address or id of the attendee or buyer, newest first, a page at a time: each with its attendee, buyer, ticket, state, hold end, payment and refund. An events manager (MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE); PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise.

One registration for an events manager of its organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): its attendee and buyer, offer, occurrence and ticket, state and hold, the terms it accepted in that revision's words, its order, payment and refund, its answers' response, the entry code's revision (never the code), its actions (check-ins, corrections, cancellations) and what may be done.

A staff entry (StaffRegistration): places on a published offer of the caller's organizations for a buyer named with an address, by ticket type (lines, or ticketTypeId and quantity), held together under the offer's and its ticket types' locks or all waitlisted when they do not fit and the waitlist has room (CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), as a visitor's but outside the public window; the request key's repeat answers the first, the same key with other values OPERATION_CONFLICT. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE.

A reservation's attendees (name, optional address, in its places' order), answers (one map of the offer's questions per attendee, or one for the buyer) and the terms accepted (acceptTerms; termsRevision the one read, TERMS_CHANGED when it moved), under the offer's lock while its places are held (HOLD_EXPIRED otherwise) or waitlisted; the terms revision and its words kept; a reservation with nothing to pay confirmed. A repeat answers the first. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE (PASS's completeRegistration is the visitor's).

E's thin wrapper over Accounting's typed payment attempt (X9, purpose eventRegistration): for a completed reservation's held places, its ticket order (storeless and taxed by X1 through the organization's gateway, or the offer's store's) and a promised payment of its total committed with the attempt, then authorized at the provider with the attempt's operation key; answers the payment's state and the hosted step (a provider page or form). A repeat answers the same attempt: no second order, charge or seat. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE (PASS's startRegistrationPayment is the visitor's).

A held free place confirmed by staff at the revision read (a paid place only by its payment: PAYMENT_REQUIRED), or a place paid after its hold ended given a seat where seats are free now for every place of its payment (CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE otherwise): those places pending again and their order placed, so its approval confirms them as any order's does. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE.

A live registration cancelled at the revision read with its reason (RegistrationChange): its seat released once under the offer's lock, its entry code revoked, a paid place's refund handed to Accounting's payment services after the commit and shown pending until the provider's result, its order cancelled once none of its places is left, then the waitlist offered. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE.

A live registration's attendee corrected or substituted (a new name and optional address) at the revision read, with its reason: the old attendee's entry code revoked, a confirmed place's new code sent to the new attendee, the substitution recorded with whom it replaced; check-in history unchanged. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE.

RegistrationBatch: cancel (with a reason) or notify again each selected registration of the caller's organizations, each in a transaction of its own with its outcome (cancelled, notified, skipped, failed with its message); one that fails is named and the rest go on. At most 200. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE.

Whether the user sees a registration and its files and Chatter (CommunicationServices' visibility of the EventRegistration host): an events manager of its offer's organization only, whatever the entity filters and authorization; a call with no user sees none.
A file kept on a registration (EventRegistrationContent, the RecordFiles host) by an events manager of its organization.

The registration expiry and waitlist job (run_EventRegistrations; design §15.3), as the system: the payment attempts of registrations due for a lookup looked up and applied (a success while held pends the places and places the order, a success after the hold ended is left for review, never a seat), failed placements tried again (five times), refunds waiting on a capture handed over; then each ended hold expired once and each offer's waitlist offered in order with a hold of its own (the waiting places of an occurrence that started end). Each item in a transaction of its own; one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

The event communications job (run_EventRegistrationNotices; design §15.3): each offer's notices due now (before the start, after the end, a moved occurrence) queued once per registration, schedule and trigger as deliveries of Comms' ledger, a promotional one only with the recipient's consent at the hand-off; a cancelled event's notices are not queued and a changed place's are suppressed at the attempt. Each place in a transaction of its own.
Internal (after a cancellation commits): the offer's first waiting places that fit offered, in waitlist order, with a hold of their own and a notice.

Internal, the EventRegistrationOrderStatus SECA: a ticket order approved confirms its pending places once (and sends their tickets); cancelled or rejected cancels its live places once and hands each paid place's refund to Accounting. Any other order is left alone.

Internal (after a cancellation commits, and the job): a cancelled paid place's refund handed to the payment services: release#SinglePayment of an authorization once none of its places is left, else refund#SinglePayment of the place's line and tax once taken, each with the registration's operation key; the result kept on the place (refunded, or Accounting's to finish).
Internal (after a seat is given to a reviewed place): the reservation's payment applied and its order placed.
Internal (after a registration's change commits): its receipt, ticket, waitlist offer, status or cancellation and the offer's notices of that trigger queued on Comms' ledger and attempted once.

The ledger's source MdsrcEventRegistration, before each attempt: the receipt, ticket (a new entry code, the earlier one revoked, and an online occurrence's link), offer, status or cancellation of a registration, or an offer's notice with its Comms template; a link to MyRegistration with a capability made for this attempt; suppressed when the registration, offer or event changed so it no longer applies. Internal.

EntryLookup and EntryDecision: the offer's door (its title, occurrence, how many are checked in, whether it is open now) and, for an entry code (or, for staff, a registration), whether that place may enter and why in words (confirmed, already checked in and when, wrong event, cancelled, expired, waitlisted, pending, unconfirmed, the event cancelled, the door closed); for a term (staff only), the offer's places whose attendee's name or address or whose id matches, at most twenty, each with its decision. The door tablet is answered the attendee as a first name and initial and nothing of the buyer, payment or answers. Changes nothing. RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for another organization's offer or another tablet's; DEVICE_REQUIRED for MARKETING_CHECKIN outside a registered device; RATE_LIMITED past the door's limit.

RecordEntry: the registration of an entry code (or, for staff, one found by name, with a reason) checked in once, under its row lock: one attendance fact per registration (EventAttendance) and its action in the registration's history; a second scan or a retry answers the first result (repeated) and writes nothing. A place that may not enter is refused with its reason code; an events manager may override a held or pending place (override, with a reason), which records the attendance and changes neither its state nor its payment; a wrong event, a cancelled, expired, waitlisted or review place, a cancelled event and a closed door are never overridden. The door tablet checks in by entry code only.

The scan-input resolver of CheckIn's entry code (the scanResolve transition's): the code read is the match, its decision the match's label (the attendee as the door shows them, the ticket) and detail, so a scan shows who it is before Confirm; a code naming no place of the offer, or one that may not enter, is refused with its reason. The same door checks and limit as preview#CheckIn.

RegistrationDetail's Attendance: whether a registration was checked in, when, how (entry code and its revision, found by name, a manager's override), by whom and why, and its decision at the door now. An events manager of its offer's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one).
